test_0430.explanation: Emotion question of the single-clip scene LM_test_0168. The stage-4 rule answers B (Quickly). The clip's duration and video bitrate suggest it is not the hurried repeat. A (Attentively) was chosen because it had the highest posterior (about 0.5) in a consistency analysis over the team's earlier public-leaderboard scores (rejection sampling over answer hypotheses), and in that analysis it could not lower the public score. This row is the only difference from submission 56255655. Both submissions scored 0.99707 public and 0.98529 private, so neither B nor A is the correct answer. The scores do not reveal whether the row is public or private.
